name: dotnet-skills
description: Claude Code marketplace for C#/.NET — two plugins, one for the legacy stack (.NET Framework 4.8 / C# 8.0) and one for the current stack (.NET 10 / C# 14). Users install only the runtime they ship.

plugins.name: dotnet-legacy
plugins.description: ASP.NET MVC 5.3, Web Forms, EF6 on .NET Framework 4.8 (C# 8.0). Includes migration patterns toward ASP.NET Core.

plugins.name: dotnet-current
plugins.description: ASP.NET Core MVC, EF Core on .NET 10 (C# 14). Modern .NET runtime patterns.
